payload.summary: On Call Teaching: the 'Next' pill prints a stale relative phrase beside the calculated date, and undated rows sort by new Date(freeText)
payload.detail: Reworded on review 2026-09-25: only the demo data was fixed in PR #2997. on-call-education-section.tsx:78 still joins the computed date with the owner's free text, deliberately (a Codex P2 review on PR #2806 kept it because it carries the time). Fix: show the computed date plus the time only, or drop a stale relative phrase such as 'Later this month'. Undated rows still sort by new Date(freeText) (line 55), which entry-model.ts forbids.
payload.source: On Call + CME audit 2026-09-24; reworded by ledger review 2026-09-25
